title: Scientology's claim to sovereign status and its Fair Game program

tellings.quote: And what it is is that they they considered themselves entitled to being considered a sovereign entity because the Catholic Church was.

plain: The Church of Scientology, a religious movement in the United States, believed it was entitled to be treated as a sovereign entity, like a country of its own, because the Catholic Church was, according to a lawyer named Dan Sheehan. Sheehan, who says he dealt with this firsthand, ties that claim to the group's Fair Game program, its policy toward people it saw as opponents.
